title: UK to cut steel import quotas, raise tariffs to protect domestic industry - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: Britain will cut its tariff-free quota on imported steel by 60% and double the tariff on excess imports to protect its domestic steel industry, amidst global trade tensions and high energy costs. The government also plans to invest in the sector and increase domestic steel production.
sentiment_reason: The decision to increase tariffs and invest in the steel industry is negative for international trade relations and may lead to higher costs for steel-dependent industries, but it is seen as a necessary step to protect a strategically important domestic industry facing decline.
